specs.title: CONTRACT-01: ScenarioSet v2 Root Schema & ID Compliance
CONTRACT-02: Intent ACCEPT_ORDER specifies required orderId and payment slots
CONTRACT-03: orderId Slot Definition & Prompt Contract
CONTRACT-04: payment Slot Definition & Prompt Contract
CONTRACT-05: Action Payload template interpolation for orderId and payment
CONTRACT-06: Final step is strictly terminal kind="end" with zero targetState hints
CANCEL-01: Cancellation after partial slot (orderId: 1001) terminates dialogue with 0 executions
CANCEL-02: Cancellation immediately after initial prompt terminates with 0 executions
CANCEL-03: Old slot utterance ("Картой") after cancellation CANNOT resurrect cancelled dialogue
CANCEL-04 & CROSS-LIFECYCLE: New order (1002) after cancelled order (1001) executes strictly 1002
RECOVERY-01 & RECOVERY-02: Invalid responses preserve partial slots and multi-turn error recovery succeeds
RECOVERY-03: Repeated attempt after error completes original Dialogue State with executionCount === 1
NEG-01 & NEG-02: Cancelled dialogue emits zero events and cannot be resurrected
NEG-03: Independent Intent after cancellation does NOT trigger cancelled ACCEPT_ORDER
IDEMP-01: Repeated cancellation preserves CANCELLED status without errors or executions
IDEMP-02: Duplicate valid slot utterance after completion yields strictly executionCount === 1
